definitions: A person who advocates thorough or complete political or social reform; a member of a radical party.
A root of a number or quantity.
A group of atoms that behaves as a single unit and often forms part of a molecule.
A distinctive component of a Chinese character, often indicating its general semantic category.
examples: The square root is a type of radical.
The hydroxyl radical is highly reactive.
The water radical is common in Chinese characters.
